prompt: How many Los Angeles Metro Rail stations are served by both the A Line and at least one other Metro Rail line?
answer:
7 stations. 

They are the five A/E shared stations—Pico, 7th/Metro, Grand Av Arts/Bunker Hill, Historic Broadway, and Little Tokyo/Arts District—plus Union Station (B/D Lines) and Willowbrook/Rosa Parks (C Line).
